text: Another app that requires you to create an account, to log-in, so that you can use it, so that you can test it. That's obviously not the right way to get more users. I always try the apps before making a commitment, before creating an account, before connecting it to my email addresses. What happened to those apps where we the users can test the app before giving our personal info?; something that's absolutely not necessary for some initial tests.

I'm a real estate appraiser and this app is great for organizing my routes. It's pay as you need which I feel is great value. If I'm slow for a month I'm not stuck paying a fee for an app I don't use. If I'm super busy then I have no qualms paying for extra credits. The app's functionality is fantastic. Once you check off a stop it automatically loads Google maps with the next address. It's very fluid and seamless. I've tried a bunch of routing apps and this is the best by far.

Kind of inconsistent, I go to the same addresses every week and it randomly sends me to a drastically different number. Update 10/18: After being advised to use GPS instead of address input due to my location most of my navigating to wrong locations has been corrected. The past few weeks it has begun to send me to the wrong part of town with some entries, but if I hit navigate a 2nd time it corrects itself. Be sure to double check where your nav is sending you.
